overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs DCT 304 Stainless Steel XL is a premium wellness solution designed for those seeking relaxation and rejuvenation at home. With its spacious and ergonomic design, this unit offers a luxurious experience, perfect for enhancing muscle relaxation and stress relief. Crafted with a durable 304 stainless steel interior and a premium Pacific Cedar exterior, it ensures long-lasting quality and elegance. Ideal for installation in basements or fitness rooms, this product includes a child-safe access system and an optional chiller for customized comfort, making it a standout choice for health-conscious individuals.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: Immerse yourself in the next level of recovery with our state-of-the-art cold plunge pools. Designed for peak performance and ultimate rejuvenation, Dynamic Cold Therapy brings you the power of icy immersion in the comfort of your own space.
_raw.Feature 1\nDelivery: This item will be delivered curbside only on a pallet by a freight carrier.
Features: Premium Pacific Cedar and Stainless Steel Exterior: The tub's exterior is crafted from the finest Pacific Cedar trim, renowned for its natural beauty and resilience against the elements and Stainless Steel cabinet. This premium stainless steel cabinet provides a great look and protects the cold plunge from the outdoor weather elements. The Pacific Cedar trim adds a touch of elegance to your outdoor or indoor spaces but also promises lasting durability.
304 Stainless Steel Interior: Tailor your cold plunge experience with our elegant 304 Stainless Steel, which offers a sleek and premium feel.
Spacious and Ergonomic Design: With its generous dimensions (55” Length x 30” Wide x 31.5” Tall) the tub provides ample space for a comfortable and relaxing cold therapy session.

Convenient Access with Safety in Mind: The inclusion of a high-quality Pacific Cedar step ensures safe and easy entry and exit, while the custom cover with child safety latches guarantees peace of mind when the tub is not in use.
Uncompromised Quality and Assurance: The Dynamic Cold Tub Barrel comes with a 1-year warranty, underscoring our commitment to quality and your long-term satisfaction.
